result.description:
Grounded Construction Group is currently looking to recruit an experienced and qualified Bulldozer Operator to join their team in Muchea WA.


The Bulldozer Operator is responsible for the safe and efficient operation of bulldozers to undertake bulk earthworks, clearing, site preparation, material spreading, pushing, ripping and final shaping activities across construction, civil, mining infrastructure and non-process infrastructure (NPI) projects. The role is responsible for achieving production targets while maintaining compliance with company, client and legislative requirements.

The successful candidate will need to undertake and possess:

-  Operate bulldozers safely and efficiently to undertake bulk earthworks, site preparation and construction activities. 
-  Clear vegetation, topsoil and unsuitable material from work areas in accordance with project requirements. 
-  Push, spread and level soil, rock, gravel and other construction materials. 
-  Carry out ripping, backfilling and ground preparation activities. 
-  Construct and maintain building pads, hardstands, access roads and haul roads. 
-  Perform final trim works to specified design levels and project tolerances where required. 
-  Read and work from construction drawings, survey pegs, GPS machine control systems and supervisor instructions.
-  Conduct daily pre-start inspections and complete required plant inspection documentation. 
-  Monitor equipment performance and report faults or maintenance requirements promptly. 
-  Carry out routine servicing, lubrication and minor maintenance within competency limits. 
-  Participate in pre-start meetings, toolbox meetings and safety interactions. 
-  Operate safely around personnel, mobile plant, underground services and fixed infrastructure. 
-  Maintain compliance with Grounded, client and statutory safety requirements. 
-  Complete required plant logs, inspection records and production documentation accurately. 
-  Assist with site establishment and other construction activities where required. 
-  Maintain housekeeping standards around work areas and equipment. 
-  Contribute to achieving project production, quality and safety objectives. 


Skills and Abilities:
-  Relevant qualification equivalent to AQF Certificate II or Certificate III, or equivalent industry experience. 
-  Minimum one (1) year relevant experience operating bulldozers. 
-  Current Driver’s Licence (HR – MC Role Dependant) 
-  Operating SOA 
-  Operating VOC (2 years validity)


Salary range is $75,000 - $85,000pa commensurate with experience.

Fulltime Position available

Applications open on 20th July 2026 and closes on 20th August 2026

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted

Position: ICT Support Technician
Type: Full-time
Employer: The Trustee for Patel Family Trust (Robust IT Services)
Location: South Geelong VIC 3220
Salary: $80,000 p/a
About the Business
Robust IT Services is a dynamic and growing IT solutions provider based in South Geelong, specialising in managed IT services, infrastructure design, cloud solutions, network security, vulnerability testing, data security, and comprehensive business IT support. With a strong focus on delivering responsive, reliable, and forward-thinking technological solutions, the company has built a solid reputation for helping businesses of all sizes optimise their IT environments, mitigate risks, and drive operational success. Guided by values of innovation, quality, professionalism, and customer-centric service, Robust IT fosters a collaborative, supportive workplace culture where team members are encouraged to solve challenges, continuously develop their skills, and contribute to meaningful client outcomes in a fast-paced yet balanced environment.
About the Position
The ICT Support Technician plays a key hands-on role within Robust IT Services by providing day-to-day technical support to end-users and clients, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, and network issues, and ensuring the reliable operation of IT systems and infrastructure. This position is essential for maintaining high service standards, minimising downtime, and delivering excellent customer support across the company’s internal operations and client environments.
Key Responsibilities
Provide timely technical support and assistance to end-users, diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, network, and peripheral issues.
Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade computer systems, operating systems, applications, and network components.
Respond to user inquiries about IT problems and provide clear guidance and solutions.
Manage user accounts, permissions, and access in systems such as Active Directory and Microsoft 365.
Perform regular system backups, updates, patches, and basic security maintenance.
Troubleshoot and resolve issues with printers, mobile devices, and other peripherals.
Maintain accurate documentation of support activities, procedures, and asset records.
Collaborate with the team on IT projects, system improvements, and client support initiatives.
Ensure compliance with service level agreements and quality standards.
Requirements
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Diploma in Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
Minimum 1 year of experience in IT support, helpdesk, or a similar technical role.
Strong technical skills in troubleshooting hardware and software issues, Microsoft environments (including Office 365 and Active Directory), networking fundamentals, and remote support tools.
Excellent customer service, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical users.
Ability to work independently and as part of a small team in a fast-paced environment.
How to Apply
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

CQ Sawmilling Pty Ltd, established on 1st March 2022, has taken over the family business of S.T. Olive & Sons. With a legacy of approximately 50 years in Dingo, S.T. Olive & Sons have specialized in supplying timber for both underground and open-cut mining industries and structural hardwood to the wholesale and retail sector. The sawmill has a history of providing “Link n Lock” roofing timber props and other specialized mining timbers to mines in Central Queensland—a service that CQ Sawmilling Pty Ltd intends to continue offering.

We recognise the importance of environmental commitments and will adhere to all relevant environmental laws. We strive to minimise the business's impact on the environment and will take all necessary measures to ensure compliance with environmental authority conditions. Our goal is to generate very little waste at the mills, and any waste produced will be treated appropriately before disposal. Most timber by-products, such as sawdust, woodchips, firewood, and side flitches, are sold to garden suppliers or the general public.

We are seeking highly skilled and experienced Mechanical Technicians to join and work with our team.

Your duties will include but are not limited to:
Maintaining and repairing range of mobile and sawmilling equipment
Conduct root cause analysis, fault-finding and diagnosing efficient solutions to machine breakdowns
Troubleshoot mechanical issues

Ensuring that products meet compliance regulations.
Carry out work instructions as given by Supervisor, work specifications, equipment operation.
Supports improvement projects.

Controls downtime by performing routine preventative maintenance requirements, daily equipment inspections, and monitoring machine operational performance.
Perform duties consistent with established safety rules and procedures.
Installing and commissioning new equipment as directed.
Communicating with and supporting engineers
Documenting machine safety and maintenance

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Trade Qualifications and +5 years proven relevant experience
Proficiency in diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining mechanical equipment
Strong knowledge of troubleshooting technique and problem-solving skills
Ability to interpret technical manuals, schematics, and diagrams
Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintenance tasks
Physically fit and able to work in various conditions
Ability to work well both independently and in a team environment
Strong communication skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!

Full-time ICT Business Analyst position available with competitive salary. Work in a dynamic team in Altona North, VIC 3025. Apply today through 11 Recruitment!

3 Stand-out Bullet Points:
•	Full-Time ICT Business Analyst
•	$80,000 p.a. plus superannuation 
•	Work in a professional environment.

Position Overview:
HYDAC Pty Ltd - HYDAC is a global provider of hydraulics, filtration and fluid technology solutions serving industrial sectors worldwide.
As an ICT Business Analyst at HYDAC Pty Ltd, you will be responsible for analysing business requirements and improving the digital systems that support engineering, sales, inventory, service and operational workflows. This position requires strong analytical thinking, stakeholder engagement and the ability to translate operational needs into practical ICT solutions.

Responsibilities and Tasks:

•	Work with users across engineering, sales, supply chain, service, finance and administration to formulate and document business and ICT requirements.
•	Identify, investigate and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices supporting HYDAC's hydraulic, filtration and fluid technology operations.
•	Identify system inefficiencies, deficiencies and limitations, and recommend improved business practices, system functionality and workflow behaviour.
•	Apply project management methodologies, principles and techniques to develop plans and assist with the costing, resourcing and delivery of ICT improvement projects.
•	Develop functional specifications for system developers, technology vendors and integration partners.
•	Use data and process modelling techniques to prepare clear system specifications for enterprise applications, reporting tools and system integrations.
•	Take responsibility for deploying functional solutions, including preparing and implementing system test plans to ensure acceptable quality, integrity and performance.
•	Create user guides, process documentation and training materials, and deliver training to employees using new or updated systems.
•	Act as a central reference point for ICT projects, providing guidance and information to support system proposals, priorities and decision-making.
•	Facilitate stakeholder workshops and interviews, maintain requirements traceability, and manage changes to agreed business and system requirements.
•	Coordinate system upgrades, integrations and releases with internal teams and external providers, supporting user acceptance testing, rollout and issue resolution.
•	Monitor post-implementation outcomes, analyse system performance and user feedback, and recommend continuous improvements to digital workflows and reporting.

Qualifications and Skills:

•	Relevant qualification.
•	Minimum 1 year experience as an ICT Business Analyst
•	Strong business process analysis, requirements gathering and documentation skills
•	Experience with process mapping, data modelling and functional specification development
•	Ability to analyse and improve enterprise systems, integrations and reporting workflows
•	Strong stakeholder communication, workshop facilitation, problem-solving and project coordination skills

Salary: The role offers a remuneration package of $80,000 p.a plus superannuation for a 38-hour work week.

How to Apply: 11 Recruitment is your pathway to securing this exciting opportunity. We are looking forward to facilitating your application and potentially welcoming you to a company that values expertise. Apply now and let us help you take the next step in your career.

BCE Surveying is a Licensed and Engineering Surveying company operating throughout Australia with offices in Perth, Bunbury and Sydney. Specialising in providing innovative solutions to all aspects of Civil Construction, SMP, Machine Guidance, Investigation Surveys, Terrestrial Scanning and Mobile Laser Scanning most recently Utility and 3D Subsurface mapping services.

BCE run the Trimble MX8 which is a premium survey grade mobile laser imaging system capturing fully synchronized, high-quality georeferenced point clouds and high-resolution imagery, this vehicle-mounted system is the only one of its kind in Australia.

Additionally, BCE also runs the IDS GeoRadar System which is a mobile GPR system (CART) capturing subsurface artefacts as high-resolution imagery similar to a CAT Scan of the ground.

They require a Surveyor to join their team in Bunbury, WA.

Key responsibilities include:
- Conduct Site Surveys. Prepare for civil engineering projects by leading surveys and compiling information about proposed project sites.
- Prepare Blueprints and Specifications. Support surveyors civil engineers by preparing specification sheets for entire projects or components.
- Estimate Material Needs and Costs. Maintain project budgets by estimating material needs and costs based on project specifications.
-Inspect Construction Sites. Conduct periodic inspections of sites and monitor surveyor activities.
- Perform Material Testing. Taking soil samples and analyzing them as required as well as conducting tests on construction materials and elements as required at the surveying site.
- Prepare Project Reports. Prepare progress reports, presenting them to surveyors, civil engineers and other personnel. Compare project timelines and costs to expectations and report on potential delays or issues that arise during construction.

To be considered you will need a relevant bachelor degree or higher qualification and at least two years of post-qualification employment experience as a Surveyor.

This is a full time position, an immediate start is available. A remuneration package of $80,000 - $100,000 per annum will be offered to the successful candidate.

JRT Group is a family-owned and operated throughout in Central Queensland. For over 20 years, JRT Group has shown a passion and a dedication for our work that has helped us to gain large numbers of satisfied clients. We offer everything from bulk earthworks to plant hire to our clients for a broad range of projects across the region. Our commitment to quality work and to each client we work with has made us one of the premier civil contracting companies in Central Queensland.

JRT Group is seeking qualified Fitters to join their team. The Fitter will assemble, install, maintain, and repair complex mechanical systems and equipment, ensuring they function safely and efficiently by interpreting technical drawings and fitting precise components.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret drawings and specifications
Fit and assemble mechanical parts, subassemblies, and equipment according to blueprints and technical drawings
Install machinery, equipment, and structural components with proper alignment and fit
Use various tools and machinery to assist in the assembly of a wide range of bulk material handling equipment such as conveyors, feeders and crushers
Will be fitting and assembling metal parts to fabricated production machines and other equipment
Will be using a range of tools and engineering techniques to maintain and repair mobile and fixed mechanical plant and equipment to operational standards
Utilise variety of hand tools (e.g., hammers, rulers), power tools, and measuring instruments to complete tasks accurately
Perform regular maintenance, conduct diagnostic tests on malfunctioning systems, and repair or replace defective parts to ensure proper function
Inspect components for accuracy and fit, and ensure that final assemblies meet safety and quality standards
Complete daily maintenance and repair logs
Adhere to and promote Workplace Health & Safety regulations
Report any hazardous situations and be aware of responsibility in the event of an emergency
Report any items requiring maintenance
Ensure that safety precautions are adhered to when using equipment
Access and have the ability to complete Job Risk Assessments

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certifications and qualifications
Proven experience working as a fitter
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Proficiency with hand and power tools
Strong knowledge of mechanical systems, fabrication, and installation processes
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the
workplace
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong communication, time management, and organisational skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual, and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
